text: Based on the evidence provided, no significant tree-cover loss events (0.5 hectares or more) were detected on the property since 2021. However, there were minor losses amounting to 0.4 hectares in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares in 2021. These small changes might not have been captured as events due to the resolution limits of the observation tools. Therefore, while no large-scale tree-cover loss was detected, minor changes may have occurred and gone unrecorded.
